An '''agrifactory''' was an agricultural facility used by the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] on their [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Research Station Shantipole]]. Topped by a giant dome, the agrifactory maintained a tropical temperature. Hundreds of six-foot tall grow walls were located in the agrifactory, arranged in rows lining the room. Large [[Water/Legends|water]] distribution machinery was located in one corner, and [[Solar collector/Legends|solar panels]] were used within the facility. The grow walls were used to cultivate the [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] [[magenge]], which was eaten exclusively by the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]].<ref name="SFS" />
